A longer document, to show what the engine looks like in use. Everything here
ran when the page was built.

## Primes

```{gp}
p = nextprime(10^40)
factor(p - 1)
```

```{gp}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
printf("`p` has %d decimal digits and %d binary digits.\n", #Str(p), exponent(p) + 1);
```

## Elliptic curves

The modular curve $X_0(11)$:

```{gp}
E = ellinit([0, -1, 1, -10, -20]);
[E.disc, E.j]
```

Its conductor, analytic rank and the first coefficients of its $L$-series:

```{gp}
ellglobalred(E)[1]
ellanalyticrank(E)
ellan(E, 12)
```

```{gp}
#| label: fig-ell
#| fig-cap: "The upper branch of the real locus of $X_0(11)$"
#| fig-alt: "A curve rising from zero as x increases"
\\ y^2 + y = x^3 - x^2 - 10x - 20, solved for the upper y
up(x) = my(d = 1 + 4*(x^3 - x^2 - 10*x - 20)); if (d < 0, 0, (-1 + sqrt(d))/2);
plothexport("svg", X = 5.05, 12, up(X))
```

## Number fields

$\mathbb{Q}(\sqrt[3]{2})$:

```{gp}
K = bnfinit(x^3 - 2, 1);
[K.disc, K.no, K.reg]
```

```{gp}
K.zk
K.fu
```

`precision: 50` applies to the whole page:

```{gp}
Pi
exp(1)

```

## Sums and series

```{gp}
sumdiv(2^10 * 3^5, d, d)
sum(n = 1, 1000, 1/n^2) * 1.0
Ser(exp(x), x, 8)
```

## Modular forms

```{gp}
mf = mfinit([1, 12], 1);
f = mfbasis(mf)[1];
mfcoefs(f, 10)
```
